name: Design B: separate globe window served by the desktop shell, outside the payload
status: research design; nothing ships; payload/ and desktop/ unchanged; blocked by owner decision O1
checked: 2026-10-17; repo HEAD 195d68c on the pilot branch (name omitted); live checks listed at the end
summary: A second private server inside the shell (desktop/globe/): a waitress thread on 127.0.0.1 with a random port, a per-launch key, a Host check and its own cookie hw_globe, following the D2 gate (launcher.py:145-207). The library (pinned, sha384-checked, fetched at build time, never committed) and any decoders ship in the installer. The payload writes an append-only snapshot table (matched alerts, places, frame metadata); the globe reads it through a read-only SQLite connection. The payload shows a link only when the shell passes GLOBE_URL, so SHELL_API and min_shell can stay unchanged. Three facts govern it: (1) the desktop app is parked by D27 and AGENTS.md names the website as the product, so the design needs an owner reversal first; (2) continuous raw decoding on each crew machine would download 64.6 GB per machine-month of GOES and 432.3 GB of MRMS at 33 levels (computed), so MRMS volumes need a published statewide product; (3) the installer gains about 35.0 MB of Windows wheels (netCDF4, numpy) plus 2.1 to 13.1 MB of library files, while the zipball grows only by code (about 67 KB compressed, computed).
repo_gate: DECISIONS.md:314-323 (D27, 2026-10-14): desktop app parked, not deleted; no version bump, no installer built; the product is the static site. AGENTS.md:7-14 says the same; ROADMAP.md:6-7 and Next 15 (:80-82) leave keep-or-delete to Carson. Consequence: no desktop or payload work starts until a DECISIONS entry names D27 and reverses it (O1).

duties.duty: Catch library script load errors and show the same banner
duties.why: script load and error events exist only in the page

duties.duty: Create the viewer from Python-supplied options: no ion token, base picker and geocoder off, ellipsoid terrain
duties.why: viewer objects exist only in the page; ion defaults are documented (globe-libs.json facts 31-33)

duties.duty: Request /globe/api/state at load and then at the interval Python sends

duties.duty: When a request fails, show the server's last text with 'could not refresh'; never draw an all-clear
duties.why: only the page knows its request failed

duties.duty: Add, remove and reorder imagery and data sources from Python's tile URLs and GeoJSON
duties.why: tile fetches and GPU upload happen only in the page

duties.duty: Show or hide a layer on checkbox change
duties.why: input events exist only in the page

duties.duty: Select a frame index from Python's frame list on slider input; never interpolate
duties.why: input events exist only in the page

duties.duty: On hover or tap, show Python-written text for the picked feature (name, valid time, retrieved time, state)
duties.why: pointer events and the library's pick exist only in the page

duties.duty: Count tile load failures per layer and print the count; state still comes from Python
duties.why: tile load events exist only in the page

duties.duty: Size voxel points from camera distance using Python's constants (rendering only; owner ruling needed)
duties.why: the camera exists only in the page; prototype globe.js section 8 does this

duties.duty: Pause polling and drawing while the window is hidden; resize the canvas

duties.duty: Phase 4 only: step through Python's frame list on a timer for playback

library_pin_and_integrity.pin: desktop/globe/libs.lock.json in git (about 2 KB): name, exact version, registry URL, licence, publish date, sha384 of each shipped file. No ranges, no 'latest'.
library_pin_and_integrity.build: build.py downloads the exact files, checks sha384 and licence, bundles LICENSE and NOTICE, and fails on any mismatch. Library bytes are never committed.
library_pin_and_integrity.runtime: C1 checks the same sha384 before serving; a mismatch or missing file gives '3D view could not load' (not a data state). No CDN at runtime (AGENTS rule 4 binds the site; the shell follows it by choice); the prototype's cdnjs tags with SRI (index.html:14-18) are replaced.
library_pin_and_integrity.age_rule_proposal: pin only versions published at least 14 days earlier. Ages on 2026-10-17 from npm time fields: cesium 1.146.0 16 days; three 0.186.1 23; deck.gl 9.4.0 42; globe.gl 2.46.2 56; maplibre-gl 6.14.0 6 (ineligible until 2026-10-25).

library_pin_and_integrity.ion_and_google: no ion token, ion asset or Google 3D Tiles in v1; Viewer overrides must make zero ion requests (needs a network trace; unverified, globe-libs.json open question)

data_endpoints: GET /globe: C1; page; 404 when the setting is off
GET /globe/static/<name>: C1; allow-list from libs.lock.json only; else 404
GET /globe/api/state: C1 reads snapshot rows and applies the thresholds carried in the snapshot (payload-owned; same rule as Feed.judge at weather.py:232, parity-tested); no POST routes exist

GET /globe/api/alerts: payload writer (C6): AlertService.refresh (weather.py:516), AlertService.active (578), applies_to_place (593), applies_to_area (610), ZoneService.ensure (635); the same rows feed Live Storms, which gives parity by construction

NWS radar, flat (D7 layer 1): browser fetches WMS tiles from the NWS WMS host (D7; host to be read from radar-tiles.json, not re-read here) allowed by CSP img-src; time from RadarService.refresh (weather.py:673) and Feed.view (weather.py:238)
GET /globe/api/volume/<frame>: C2; statewide product frames (0.732 MB per active frame, pipeline-options.json option D); thresholds 35 and 50 dBZ, 20 optional
GET /globe/api/goes/<frame>: C2; ACHAC 0.32 MB or ACHA2KMC about 4.5 MB per 5-min file (goes-aws.json); band 13 at 2 km
GIBS GOES drape: browser direct; C1 builds the TIME parameter; tiles carry Access-Control-Allow-Origin * (gibs.json)
base map: browser direct; owner choice: USGS raster (D9, public domain) or the site's vector basemap (D28, tools/build_basemap.py)

freshness_and_kinds.proposed_kinds: satellite_image (observation: GOES drape); satellite_estimate (ACHA cloud-top height: estimate of the top only; legend says cloud base not observed). D12 has no satellite kind (DECISIONS.md D12; supervisor log); new kinds need a DECISIONS entry (proposal P-B1).
freshness_and_kinds.limits: alerts Stale after 10 min (D12, existing). NWS radar Stale after 15 min (D12, existing), Unavailable after 60 min (proposal). MRMS volume Stale after 10 min since valid time, Unavailable after 30 min (proposal; latency 29-120 s, mrms.json reviewed). GOES ACHA from AWS Stale after 20 min, Unavailable after 60 min (proposal; latency medians 98-115 s, goes-aws.json). GOES drape via GIBS Stale after 60 min, Unavailable after 3 h (proposal; labels 19-45 min late, frames 76-96 min late, gibs.json). Base map has no state (not evidence; supervisor log).
freshness_and_kinds.engineering: limits live in payload weather.FRESH_SECONDS (weather.py:205) and travel in the snapshot; a unit test fails on any layer key missing from the table (weather.py:232 silently defaults unlisted keys to 3600 s)

null_geometry_alerts: Polygon present and contains the place: outline only (no fill); text 'Warning area includes this place' with NWS valid and end times
Polygon null, and the place's zone, county or fire code matches the UGC codes: zone outline if ZoneService has geometry; otherwise a marker at the place and the text 'Zone alert; NWS gave no outline'
Codes not yet known for the place (applies_to_place can't-tell; D10): 'Can't tell yet' marker and text; never omitted, never 'no alert'
Failed refresh keeps the last verified list with its time; nothing is cleared (D11, rule 6)
Opacity never encodes severity; no extruded walls (supervisor product critic)

Parity test on zone-only, out-of-state and cancel-during-outage fixtures: same alert IDs as Live Storms (supervisor ACCEPT list). All 19 Montana alerts had null geometry at D10 time (DECISIONS.md D10).
storms_3d: Vertical coordinate: MRMS levels are heightAboveSea in metres, 500 to 19,000 m, 33 levels (mrms.json confirmed). Label them 'height above sea level', never 'above ground' (rendering-options.json legend rules).

Below ground: cells under the local ground elevation (a Python ground grid; source per the terrain work, not re-read here) are not drawn; legend 'Below ground: not drawn; not clear'. That the 0.5 km level lies below ground over most of Montana is a plan constraint, not a value checked here.
No-data codes -99 and -999 both mean 'no radar data' until NSSL's table is read (mrms.json unverified; NSSL page returned 503). Draw hatched 'No radar data'; never 0 dBZ; never clear.
Thresholds: 35 and 50 dBZ proposed, 20 optional (rendering-options.json question 2); counts must match numpy on the same crop (evaluation-predeclared.json threshold_count_parity).
Legend (rendering-options.json legend rules): 'Radar echo strength (dBZ). Estimate from radar, not observed hail or damage. Grey or hatched: no radar data, not clear.'

No interpolation: frames show valid times; missing 2-minute slots are gaps (evaluation-predeclared.json missing_slot_shown_as_gap, decision_time_leaks). Opacity encodes echo class only; no severity ramp, storm-motion arrows or probability shells.

Clouds: 'cloud top only; cloud base not observed'. ACHA heights are 'geopotential, about sea level' (rendering-options.json; goes-aws.json ATBD quote). Uncorrected parallax wording from parallax.json until phase 2.

route_security_tests: 1 any /globe route without the hw_globe cookie: 403 (page, static, api)
2 cookie with a wrong value: 403 (hmac compare, as launcher.py:145-207)
3 Host other than 127.0.0.1:<port> or localhost:<port>: 400 (launcher.py:161 pattern)
4 /globe/__auth?k=<wrong>: 403; right key: 303 with Set-Cookie hw_globe; HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict
5 the main app's hw_session cookie is rejected: cookies do not isolate by port (RFC 6265 section 8.5, fetched and verified: 'Cookies do not provide isolation by port.')
6 POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE on any route: 405; a grep test finds no write route
7 traversal (../, %2e%2e%2f, %2F, backslash, absolute path, symlink in vendor/): 404; allow-list only
8 unknown query parameters ignored; frame ids must match the snapshot pattern, else 400

9 every response: CSP default-src 'none'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self' blob: plus named tile hosts; connect-src 'self' plus tile hosts; frame-ancestors 'none'; X-Content-Type-Options nosniff; Referrer-Policy no-referrer; api routes Cache-Control no-store; no Access-Control-Allow-Origin header
10 a 500 shows recovery text, never a traceback or path (launcher.py:209 pattern)
11 database opened with mode=ro; a write raises; file size and mtime unchanged after a full test session
12 setting off or missing: 404 on /globe and its api
14 socket bound to 127.0.0.1 only; port differs from the main app's
15 per-launch key of at least 256 bits, never logged; a new launch rejects the old cookie
16 Playwright (dev and CI): request interception shows only allow-listed hosts; zero CSP violations on load

installer_churn_and_updates.new_installer: any change under desktop/globe (server, template, globe.js, CSS); library version or sha384 pin; decoder wheels or requirements.txt; launcher.py or build.py changes
installer_churn_and_updates.no_installer: payload snapshot writer, thresholds, alert matching, places, settings default (zipball, via the D3-D6 channel)
installer_churn_and_updates.reach_crews: payload updates arrive through the existing hourly check (D6). Installers arrive by manual download from a GitHub Release (build-desktop.yml:70); the shell never updates itself; a payload that needs a newer shell shows 'A new desktop installer is needed' with a link (D3).
installer_churn_and_updates.schema_gate: the snapshot carries a schema number; C1 refuses unknown numbers with '3D view needs a newer desktop installer' (the D3 pattern); in-process swaps (D5) cannot break C1 silently
installer_churn_and_updates.variant_B2: lower churn: page and globe.js in the payload, library and decoders in the shell, same-origin library files. Costs a payload-to-library API contract and breaks 'the payload only links to it' (task constraint). Offered for O4; not the default.

risks_ranked: 1 Product direction: D27 parks the desktop app and AGENTS.md names the website as the product (DECISIONS.md:314-323; AGENTS.md:7-14). Blocks design B until reversed.

2 WebGL2 on Windows unknown: WebView2 WebGL2 is not stated on the pages read; with .NET 4.6.2+ and no WebView2, pywebview picks MSHTML (no WebGL2) with no browser fallback (webgl-runtime.json; winforms.py:94, 147-155). WebView2 Fixed Version is over 250 MB.

3 Raw decode bandwidth: 64.6 GB (GOES) and 432.3 GB (MRMS) per machine-month if continuous (computed). The product path needs a publisher; Actions has a 5-minute schedule floor and an open terms reading (hosting-options.json gh-sched-1, gh-terms-1 to -3; quotes unreviewed here).
4 Installer churn and manual delivery: one installer per OS per shell change (build.py:4); crews download by hand; no automatic shell update (D3).
5 Shared SQLite: no journal_mode is set (store.py:79-82; timeout 10 s); a reader's locks can stall the payload writer; WAL behaviour unverified (sqlite.org returned 503 twice).

6 Second server: the prototype server has no session key or Host check (serve.py: 0 matches for cookie or key code; bound to 127.0.0.1 at serve.py:1237). Copy the D2 gate with its own cookie (RFC 6265 section 8.5).

7 Library and licence: Viewer defaults call ion (globe-libs.json facts 31-32); VoxelPrimitive and deck.gl GlobeView are experimental (facts 35, 42); a custom volume shader adds hand-written JavaScript (rule 4).

8 Honest display: uncorrected tops sit 3 to 4 km off for a 2 km top and 20 to 33 km off for 12 to 15 km (parallax.json); cloud base not observed; -99 and -999 unverified; MESH units unverified (mrms.json).
9 Data terms: GOES files carry 'Access is restricted to approved users only' while the registry says open (goes-aws.json); wording for counsel.
10 Test gap: CI has no browser step (app-integration.json; check-app.yml:22-26); the prototype's browser suite takes 127 s (prototype-globe.json timings).
11 Hardware: RAM floor and GPU class undecided (D-G7); the decode worker peaks at 409 MB (prototype-mrms.json).
12 Schema drift: the payload swaps in-process on update (D5); a snapshot change must hit the schema gate, not crash the globe.
13 Supply chain: maplibre-gl 6.14.0 is 6 days old on 2026-10-17 (npm time field); the pin rule blocks it until 2026-10-25.
owner_decisions: O1 Revive the desktop app by a DECISIONS entry naming D27, or keep the website-first path (ROADMAP Next 15).
O2 D-G1: allow a bundled WebGL library and duties G-JS1 to G-JS13; choose the library (CesiumJS 1.146.0 as prototyped but bundled; three.js with more hand code; MapLibre globe, ESM only, 6 days old).
O3 Where MRMS volumes are decoded: on each machine (netCDF4, eccodes; Windows untested) or as a published statewide product (site job or server; Actions terms; host cost).
O4 Accept one installer per OS per globe change, or choose variant B2.
O5 Default-off: accept library and decoder bytes in every installer while off, or split installers.
O6 Scope: Montana plus border (D-G3); whether a worldwide static layer is allowed.
O7 GOES product: ACHA2KMC (2 km, 4.4 to 4.5 MB per 5-min file) or ACHAC (10 km, 0.32 MB) (rendering-options.json question 1).
O8 dBZ classes: 35 and 50 first, 20 optional (rendering-options.json question 2).
O9 Hardware floor (D-G7); whether crews without WebView2 are supported or must install the runtime (over 250 MB).
O10 Audience: whether the 3D view reaches homeowners, adjusters or insurers; DEMO refusal on /globe (supervisor owner questions).
O11 Counsel: GOES banner and NOAA attribution wording.
